'''Sommel Atandu''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[sergeant]] of the [[Canto Bight Police Department]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]. He wore a light [[Color|blue]] uniform [[Clothing|tunic]] with black stripes on the [[Limb|arms]] and a [[betaplast]] [[armor]]ed collar, neck guard and [[helmet]], as well as a pair of blue pants, a white [[belt]], a black [[Cloak|cape]] and black highly polished [[synth-hide]] officer's [[boot]]s. As an [[officer]] of the law, he was equipped with a scrambled long-range [[comlink]], an [[electro-shock stunprod]] and a [[Relby K-25 blaster|K-25 blaster]]. Atandu had light skin, brown [[eye]]s and black [[hair]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sommel Atandu first appeared in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
